adjudication.rationale: In `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts`, the refresh call is wrapped with `refreshOAuthTokens(..., credential.userId)`, which only uses the sync endpoint when `userId` is truthy. However `parseRefreshTokenResponse(responseJson, refreshTokenResponseSchema)` decides whether to use the permissive `minimumTokenResponseSchema` solely based on `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED && process.env.CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` (no `userId`/team check). That means for team credentials (where `credential.userId` is falsy, so the real Microsoft token endpoint is called) the response can be parsed with the permissive schema, and if `refresh_token` is missing it is forcibly set to the string literal `"refresh_token"`. The subsequent merge `o365AuthCredentials = { ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }` will overwrite the stored refresh token and `prisma.credential.update` persists it, causing credential corruption/data loss.
